messages:
riley (partnerships): Heads-up: partner asks for a combined listing — Snowflake connector + Databricks runtime compatibility + Milvus sample app. Also need to confirm NVIDIA A30 certification docs for marketplace tile. Who can own the compatibility matrix?
maria (eng-runtime): I can take the runtime matrix. quick note: Snowflake External Functions path behaves differently than our UDF shim. might need small adjustments for socket timeouts.
noah (field-eng): Milvus testing ok locally. will run ingest/recall at scale tomorrow. suggest 50k vectors baseline (128-d).
zoe (product): timeline from partner: want marketplace draft by Apr 14 to meet co-marketing. If we can't cert A30 by then, partner wants to delay. Legal flagged data-flow diagram for External Functions.
partners-bot: Checklist: marketplace tile, billing SKU, datasets for sample app, partner logo assets, HW cert PDF. Link: https://drive.redwood/partners/marketplace-checklist :pushpin:
infra-ci: nightly-connector-tests: all green on databricks connector (run 2026-03-04T03:12Z). Snowflake External Functions tests: 2 failures (socket timeout, auth header length).
maria (eng-runtime): noted. the socket timeout is likely due to ephemeral NAT behavior in Snowflake. recommendation: switch to persistent connection pool inside connector init. will prototype.
noah (field-eng): running Milvus ingest now. I'll capture throughput and memory profile. command I use: `python bench_ingest.py --host milvus.test --vectors 50000 --dim 128 --batch 1024`
noah (field-eng): quick numbers so far: ingest ~6500 vectors/s, avg RAM 6.8GB. will post full CSV to /reports/partners/1806001234.
\oz partners-bot (typo): sorry ignore
riley (partnerships): lol. please delete that stray message.
zoe (product): can someone assemble the data-flow diagram for External Functions? legal wants the diagram and the privacy bullet points.
maria (eng-runtime): I'll sketch it and post PNG. also opening issue PART-4920 "Snowflake External Functions: persistent conn for connector". linking tests and PR once prototype is up.
noah (field-eng): added Milvus + Redis vector store runs to the perf sheet. Milvus QPS 1k at k=10 on p95.
partners-bot: Partner assets request: partner-logo.svg due Tue, sample dataset (>=10k rows) due Tue.
riley (partnerships): decision: aim for Apr 21 co-announcement unless all certs/diagrams good by Apr 14. owners: maria (runtime changes + Snowflake diagram), noah (Milvus perf + reports), zoe (marketplace tile + legal coord). weekly checkpoint invite coming.
zoe (product): copying partner contact. will draft marketplace content and share for review.
maria (eng-runtime): ETA prototype by Thu EOD. will include perf regressions check.
noah (field-eng): will finalize perf CSV and screenshots by Wed.
riley (partnerships): thanks everyone. ping #release-war-room if blockers.
